intro.text: Owner and bartender of All's Alley, a bar in the Urithiru breakaway market.

items.text: Aware of the murders near his bar, Sullik feared that investigators would shut it down. When Shallan asked him about them, he refused to give details and pointed her to the thugs he had hired.

appearance.text: A large man who wears a takama; he may or may not be a lighteyes.

personality.text: He keeps Horneater white behind the bar as a joke, knowing only that it strips paint well. He knows when to cut patrons off and has little patience for troublemakers.
